Haryana Police Arrests Journalists Over 'Fake Sting' Allegations

Haryana Police have arrested the Managing Director of Living India News and three journalists in connection with a 'fake sting' operation. Kurukshetra police claim the operation targeted Haryana Chief Minister Saini ahead of Punjab polls. The opposition has criticized the arrests, describing them as an 'attack on the press'.
